name: zwdy7z-sealed-tracker
goal: Prove sealed Tracker journal delivery and cursor replay, then verify a backed-up hub and spoke cutover by canonical count and hash.

evidence: Merged spec PR #310 and wire contract PR #315 reviewed. Full cutover requires approved production endpoint and enrolled device grants. Local first slice proves durable retry and authenticated pull with atomic cursor.
636982330b: opt-in supervisor, durable upload and cursors, scoped replay and backup row comparison; no live activation.
636982330b: disposable hub and spoke converge across paginated replay with matching scoped count/SHA-256, preserved note and tombstone, durable restart, and exclusion of an out-of-scope item.
